title: Play Format
description: A way to play: which sets are legal (card pool) + which restriction list applies. NRDB v2 pattern: formats, pools, and restrictions are separate documents so banlists version independently of cards. Files: formats/*.yaml.

card_pool.description: Set IDs legal in this format. Every ID must exist in sets.

active_restriction_id.description: The currently-active restriction document (restrictions/*.yaml). Omit if no banlist.

deck_rules.description: Deckbuilding constraints, if the game has decks.
